# vite-plugin-seo-meta

> Generated by docmd

## Overview

- [vite-plugin-seo-meta](https://nellowtcs.me/vite-plugin-seo-meta/)
  All-in-one Vite plugin that generates meta tags, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, JSON-LD, hreflang, robots.txt and sitemap.xml for your app.

## API

- [API](https://nellowtcs.me/vite-plugin-seo-meta/api/)
  Public exports: seo(), defineSeoConfig() and the runtime helper.

## Getting Started

- [Configuration](https://nellowtcs.me/vite-plugin-seo-meta/getting-started/configuration/)
  Every option the plugin accepts, with defaults.
- [Installation](https://nellowtcs.me/vite-plugin-seo-meta/getting-started/installation/)
  Install vite-plugin-seo-meta and set up its peer dependency.
- [Quick Start](https://nellowtcs.me/vite-plugin-seo-meta/getting-started/quickstart/)
  Add SEO to a Vite app in two minutes.

## Guide

- [hreflang](https://nellowtcs.me/vite-plugin-seo-meta/guide/hreflang/)
  Tell search engines which language and region variant of a page to show.
- [JSON-LD](https://nellowtcs.me/vite-plugin-seo-meta/guide/json-ld/)
  Structured data for search engines: Organization, WebSite, Article, Product, BreadcrumbList and ImageObject.
- [Meta Tags](https://nellowtcs.me/vite-plugin-seo-meta/guide/meta-tags/)
  How the plugin emits title, description, canonical and robots meta tags.
- [Open Graph](https://nellowtcs.me/vite-plugin-seo-meta/guide/open-graph/)
  og:* tags for Facebook, LinkedIn and every platform that reads them.
- [robots.txt](https://nellowtcs.me/vite-plugin-seo-meta/guide/robots/)
  Generate robots.txt following RFC 9309 with agent groups, wildcards and crawl delays.
- [sitemap.xml](https://nellowtcs.me/vite-plugin-seo-meta/guide/sitemap/)
  Generate sitemap.xml with image, video and news namespaces, plus URL caps.
- [SPA Runtime](https://nellowtcs.me/vite-plugin-seo-meta/guide/spa-runtime/)
  Update SEO tags when the URL changes in a single-page app.
- [Twitter Cards](https://nellowtcs.me/vite-plugin-seo-meta/guide/twitter/)
  How the plugin emits twitter:* tags for summary, player and app cards.
- [Validation](https://nellowtcs.me/vite-plugin-seo-meta/guide/validation/)
  Catch misconfigured SEO before it ships.

## Reference

- [Config Reference](https://nellowtcs.me/vite-plugin-seo-meta/reference/config/)
  Every field the plugin accepts.
